To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) difficulties are an unavoidable part of the learning processes; 2) difficulties are particularly challenging for students in digital learning environments where the teacher’s presence is not as readily apparent; 3) difficulties are particularly important for conceptual learning; and, 4) there are different types of difficulties that can be experienced by learners, and some of these types are more conducive to productive learning than others.
the optimal learning environment is one in which students are provided with sufficient information to be confused but not too confused.
difficulties are an unavoidable and important part of the process of learning.
